findings.diagnostic_code_behavior: realized ledgers are constructed in-memory during replay; only ledger hashes and aggregate diagnostics are written to the final diagnostic JSON

scientific_conclusion: Stage7 derived artifacts preserve sufficient evidence to reproduce aggregate economic failure diagnostics but not a complete per-race winner-label table for burned A+B.
The Stage7 failure diagnostic code confirms the realized ledger is generated in memory from raw settlement inputs and not emitted as a standalone ledger artifact.

Therefore frozen Candidate A versus B1a winner-probability calibration cannot be completed from the located derived artifacts alone without either discovering another previously authorized per-race outcome derivative or obtaining explicit authorization to reopen burned A/B raw settlement outcomes.
No protected C or ECON_HOLDOUT1000 data were opened in this diagnostic.
